tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zung 'jug rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// padma saṃ bha ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// ting 'dzin bzang po o rgyan las 'phro gling*// karma rig 'dzin karma chags med zhabs// padma kun dga' phrin las dbang 'byung rje// shes rab grags pa bstan 'dzin don kun grub/ theg mchog bstan 'phel rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs// 'gyur med bde ba dbang chen rta mchog dpal// spros bral stong nyid rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug gu ru yid bzhin nor bu la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// thabs mchog snang ba'i rang bzhin pho rgyud dang*// shes rab stong pa'i rang rtsal mo rgyud tshogs// gnyis med ma ning rgyud gsum dam can la// gsol ba 'debs so phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs// snang stong lha sku grags stong sngags kyi sgra /rig stong bde chen ye shes 'khor lor shar// rang snang dbang 'dus gzhan snang zil gyis gnon// dbang chen yab yum phyag rgya myur 'grub shog /ka dag khregs chod dgongs pa'i gzer thebs shing*// lhun grub thod rgal snang bzhi'i rtsal rdzogs te// 'khor 'das chos kun gdod ma'i zad sar phyin// rigs bdag bla ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /
ces pa'ang zab chos 'di la mos pa karme shwa ras bskul ngor padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis yang dben kun bzang bde chen gling du spel ba dge legs 'phel// //
